About.title: About PT Indocoat Ishinol Utama
About.intro: PT Indocoat Ishinol Utama is the official distributor of ISHINOL — premium Japanese marble protection — in Indonesia.
About.japanBody: ISHINOL is born from decades of Japanese marble-coating science. As the appointed distributor for Indonesia, PT Indocoat Ishinol Utama imports every product directly from the source, ensuring authenticity, technical support, and the uncompromising quality that defines the ISHINOL name in Japan.
About.value1Body: Every product is genuine, imported directly from ISHINOL Japan.
About.value2Body: Japanese precision applied by certified, professional specialists.
About.value3Body: Long-term partnerships built on transparency and results.
About.value4Body: An uncompromising standard on every surface we protect.
